messages:
Nadia: uploaded new compact layout where left column is spend trend and right column is token-breakdown + invoices. putting scope toggle above timeline. PTAL :mag:
Tom: quick: where's invoice CTA? still bottom-right or floating?
Nadia: bottom-right for parity. but invoice list collapsed to a single row with an actionable pill: `Most recent invoice · $420 · Download`
Isabel: Concern: collapsing might hide past invoices. Suggest adding chevron to expand history inline rather than navigate to separate page.
Marek: +1. Also legend wrap issue at 320px — propose condensed legend with up to 3 items + "+n" overflow that opens a keyboard-focusable popover.
a11y-bot: accessibility report: 1) legend contrast <4.5:1 at small sizes; 2) scope toggle missing aria-pressed; 3) invoice pill lacks accessible name; 4) popover not reachable via keyboard.
Tom: tokens display: right panel currently mixes 1.2M and raw counts (e.g., 1,234,567). Let's standardize to compact (k/M) and show raw in tooltip.
Isabel: copy tweak: change \"Download\" to \"Download (PDF/CSV)\" might be long in some locales. Alternate: primary \"Download\" + dropdown chevron.
Marek: telemetry ask: add feature flag `billing_ui_compact` and events `billing.invoice_click`, `billing.scope_change`, `billing.download_format`. Run on 5% for 2 weeks to get time-to-download baselines.
Nadia: accessibility fixes: increase legend label contrast, add `aria-pressed` to toggle, `aria-label=\"Billing scope: org or project\"`, invoice pill should include visually hidden text \"Overdue\" when applicable. Also ensure popover uses roving tabindex and Esc to close.
Tom: microcopy under spend: \"Estimated monthly spend. Final invoice may vary.\" Small but reduces support tickets.
Isabel: UX question: when switching to Project scope, should left chart become project-only or show org-mini + project? I prefer swap to project-only and keep a breadcrumb \"Org overview\" to go back.
Marek: agreed on swap + breadcrumb. Dev note: avoid re-rendering heavy charts on toggle — consider client-side filter and animate opacity.
Nadia: great, I'll update figma frames and attach annotated diffs. will also add a short localization brief for the dropdown text. thanks :tada:
